verdict.rationale: Evidence covers authentication/authorization methods (JWT, OAuth, ACLs), Vaults for secrets, and Dev Portal visibility settings (public/private), but there is no mention of role-based access control (RBAC) or permissions for controlling who can view/edit APIs and collections within Kong's own management surfaces (e.g., Konnect teams/roles, Kong Manager RBAC). Missing for 10: RBAC/permission system documentation for internal collaborators, role-based access to Konnect/Kong Manager, evidence of granular view/edit permissions on API definitions or collections.
